newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra keeps falling after Q1 result.
newsitem.headline: Astra keeps falling after Q1 result.

text.p: Shares in Swedish drugs major Astra kept falling when the Stockholm Stock Exchange opened on Tuesday after the company released a lower than expected first quarter profit a day earlier.
At 0810 GMT, the share was nine crowns lower at 311.5, adding to a 22 crown plunge on Monday.
But it was trading ex-dividend, with four crowns taken off the price on Tuesday.
Brokers expected the share to recover from intra-day lows to close a couple of crowns lower.
"The p/e (price earnings) ratio of 19.5 is just somewhat higher than the average for the engineering sector, including Ericsson," a trader said.
"It is hard to believe that Astra will post flat full-year earnings so I see this as an opportunity to buy the share."

Astra posted a one percent rise in first quarter pre-tax profit to 3.46 billion crowns, below an expected 3.93 billion crowns. Earnings and sales were hurt by stockpiling prior to year-end 1996, the company said.
